rows.commentary: 0.1: Blessing Muzarabani drops it on a length around middle and leg, where Rahmanullah Gurbaz quietly nudges it towards mid-on.
0.2: Muzarabani offers a shade more fullness on middle and leg, easily pushed toward mid-on by Gurbaz.
0.3: Muzarabani tests the back of a length outside off, sharply knocked into the off-side by Gurbaz.
0.4: Muzarabani strays short and wide, allowing Gurbaz to stay put and crunch the match's first boundary through cover in commanding style.
0.5: Gurbaz nearly drags it onto his own stumps attempting a punch on the rise, but an inside edge allows a single.
0.6: Muzarabani shapes one back in on a length around middle and leg, clipped away to square leg by Ibrahim Zadran for one.
1.1: Brad Evans errs immediately down the leg-side for a wide as the wicketkeeper dives sharply to his left.
1.1: Evans attacks a length around off that holds its line, solidly knocked down the pitch by Zadran.
1.2: Evans pushes a fraction fuller around off, safely defended straight back down the track by Zadran.
1.3: Evans pitches this one up around middle and leg, firmly driven back toward the bowler.
1.4: Zadran times a fuller delivery exquisitely, presenting the full face of the bat to drill it past mid-on for four.
1.5: Zadran flicks a length ball through wide mid-on, collecting a brisk couple as the fielder slides to cut it off in the deep.
1.6: Brad Evans drops it on a length around middle and leg, and Ibrahim Zadran simply turns it straight to mid-on.
2.1: Blessing Muzarabani tests the batter with a slightly short delivery on middle and leg, safely nudged into the on-side by Rahmanullah Gurbaz.
2.2: Rahmanullah Gurbaz seizes on the width outside off, carving it sharply through backward point to beat the running third man fielder for four.
2.3: Blessing Muzarabani attacks the middle and leg channel, allowing Rahmanullah Gurbaz to clip it easily toward wide mid-on for a quick single.
2.4: Blessing Muzarabani digs it in short, finding the shoulder of Ibrahim Zadran's bat as he misses the pull and trickles it toward point.
2.5: Ibrahim Zadran stands tall on the crease, meeting the back-of-a-length delivery with a straight bat right back to Blessing Muzarabani.
2.6: Ibrahim Zadran drills the ball firmly through wide mid-off, scampering back eagerly to secure a comfortable couple of runs.
13.2: Ernest Masuku drops it short, and Sediqullah Atal swivels to dispatch the pull through backward square leg for four.
13.3: Masuku offers room outside off, and Sediqullah Atal unleashes a sumptuous cover drive reminiscent of Sir Alastair Cook to find the rope.
13.4: Sediqullah Atal collects a single by clipping Ernest Masuku away through backward square leg.
13.5: Ernest Masuku targets a length around middle and leg, allowing Ibrahim Zadran to nudge it toward mid-on for one.
13.6: Ernest Masuku delivers back of a length on middle and leg, which Sediqullah Atal simply dabs straight back down the pitch.
14.1: Sikandar Raza pushes a fuller trajectory through, prompting Ibrahim Zadran to return it firmly to the bowler.
14.2: Sikandar Raza drifts onto the pads, and Ibrahim Zadran tucks it through mid-wicket to rotate the strike.
14.3: Sikandar Raza drops short outside off, allowing Sediqullah Atal to carve a single square through point.
14.4: Sikandar Raza floats one fuller on middle and leg, cleanly clipped toward square leg by Ibrahim Zadran.
14.5: Ibrahim Zadran turns Sikandar Raza's delivery straight to the waiting fielder stationed at square leg.
14.6: Sikandar Raza angles a good length delivery into middle and leg, pushed toward long-on for a brisk single.
15.1: Wellington Masakadza draws a single as Ibrahim Zadran guides the ball out toward wide long-off.
15.2: Wellington Masakadza drops it back of a length into middle and leg, allowing Sediqullah Atal to bunt it away to long-on for a brisk single.
15.3: Wellington Masakadza delivers a length ball outside off that Ibrahim Zadran punches firmly towards wide long-off to bring up his landmark fifty, proudly raising his bat to the cheering crowd.
15.4: Wellington Masakadza attacks a good length around off stump, neatly knocked down to long-off by Sediqullah Atal for a comfortable run.
15.5: Wellington Masakadza strays sharply down the leg-side, prompting the umpire to stretch his arms and signal a wide.
15.5: Wellington Masakadza keeps it simple as Ibrahim Zadran pushes the delivery cleanly towards long-on to rotate the strike once more.
15.6: Wellington Masakadza lands it on a length around middle and leg, where Sediqullah Atal nudges it neatly into the mid-wicket region to close out the over.
31.1: Brad Evans hones in on a good length at middle stump, meeting a firm defensive push from Ibrahim Zadran towards mid-on.
31.2: Brad Evans digs it in short on middle, inviting Ibrahim Zadran to pull it hard past deep mid-wicket where a costly misfield leaks four runs.
31.3: Brad Evans tests the middle stump line once more on a good length, watchfully pushed towards the cover fielder by Ibrahim Zadran.
31.4: Brad Evans lands it on a tight channel outside off, shaping away as Ibrahim Zadran drives it firmly toward cover.
31.5: Brad Evans attacks the stumps on a length, securely punched down the pitch to mid-on by Ibrahim Zadran.

31.6: Brad Evans strikes with a sharp short ball into the body, inducing a top-edged pull from Ibrahim Zadran that allows Tafadzwa Tsiga to secure a tumbling catch at fine leg, sealing a brilliant 90-run innings.
32.1: Sikandar Raza drifts one short and wide outside off, permitting Sediqullah Atal to pierce the gap with a cut shot toward sweeper cover.
32.2: Sikandar Raza tosses it up on a length, neatly nudged away toward the mid-wicket region by Rahmat Shah.
32.3: Sikandar Raza darts an off-break onto middle, firmly blocked straight back down the pitch by Rahmat Shah.
32.4: Sikandar Raza fires it in on a length, safely angled into the off-side by Rahmat Shah.
32.5: Sikandar Raza offers width outside off on a short length, ruthlessly cut past point by Rahmat Shah with immaculate placement to find the boundary.
32.6: Sikandar Raza drops this good-length delivery squarely on middle, and Rahmat Shah dead-bats it firmly into the leg side.
33.1: Brad Evans drops it short outside off, allowing Sediqullah Atal to steer it toward backward point where a sharp diving stop saves the boundary.
33.2: Sediqullah Atal punches this delivery firmly toward the cover fielder, though mistiming the stroke somewhat off Brad Evans.
33.3: Brad Evans digs this one in short, and Sediqullah Atal wisely ducks underneath the line to let it sail through.
33.4: Sediqullah Atal charges down the track to Brad Evans and lofts the length ball over the cover region for a brisk two runs.
33.5: Brad Evans rattles through another short delivery angled into the middle and leg stump line.
42.4: Hashmatullah Shahidi sweeps it away cleanly, only for Bennett to sprint across the boundary line and pull off a stunning save.
42.5: Sikandar Raza drops it short outside off, allowing Hashmatullah Shahidi to carve a single through the off-side.
42.6: Sikandar Raza floats it full, and Sediqullah Atal knocks it firmly down to long-on to advance his score.
43.1: Sediqullah Atal punches the back-of-a-length delivery toward mid-off where a fumble gifts the batters a comfortable second run.
43.2: Sediqullah Atal guides the ball through square leg to inch agonizingly close to his landmark at 99.
43.3: Hashmatullah Shahidi taps it toward mid-on for a single, leaving an exasperated Raza to lament a missed run-out opportunity.
43.4: Sediqullah Atal drives past mid-on and charges back for a frantic third run to reach a magnificent third ODI century amid thunderous applause.
43.5: Hashmatullah Shahidi mistimes a pull off a short delivery, sending a top-edge swirling toward fine leg for a brace.
43.6: Masuku drops it a fraction fuller outside the off stump, allowing Hashmatullah Shahidi to lean in and stroke the ball toward mid-off to collect a single.
44.1: Sikandar Raza hurries one through full, catching a leading edge off Hashmatullah Shahidi's bat into the off-side.
44.2: Hashmatullah Shahidi seizes on width outside off, slamming the short delivery toward deep extra cover to collect two more.
44.3: Sikandar Raza slides it through flatter on the stumps, and Hashmatullah Shahidi turns it quietly into the on-side for a single.
44.4: Sikandar Raza captures the prized scalp of Sediqullah Atal, whose magnificent century ends as a misplayed slog finds Tafadzwa Tsiga charging in from the deep for a brilliant catch.
44.5: Sikandar Raza arrows one into the stumps, easily patted back down the pitch by Mohammad Nabi.
44.6: Sikandar Raza fires it in flatter on the leg stump, allowing Mohammad Nabi to clip it away through square leg for a comfortable two runs.
45.1: Brad Evans offers width outside off, and Hashmatullah Shahidi clears room before punching it crisply through the cover region for four.
45.2: Brad Evans hits a fuller length, softly tapped into the off-side by Hashmatullah Shahidi for a single.
48.6: Blessing Muzarabani digs it in short, tempting AM Ghazanfar into a pull that ends in a miscued top-edge safely pouched by Wellington Masakadza at mid-on.
49.1: Brad Evans fires in a pinpoint yorker around middle and leg, allowing Mohammad Nabi to flick it briskly through mid-wicket for a sharp couple.
49.2: Brad Evans pitches it up outside off, inviting Mohammad Nabi to go over the top before Sikandar Raza intercepts the aerial blow at deep mid-off.
49.3: Brad Evans drops it short around middle and leg, leaving Fazalhaq Farooqi swinging entirely through thin air on the pull.
49.4: Brad Evans induces a wild swing and a miss before a fumble behind the stumps allows a scrambling bye.
49.5: Brad Evans offers a delivery short of a length outside off, and Zia Ur Rahman Sharifi flashes hard only to find empty air.

49.6: Brad Evans delivers the final ball to Zia Ur Rahman Sharifi, who forces it toward mid-wicket and scrambles for a second run only to be caught short by Brendan Taylor's underarm strike at the stumps, closing the innings with a dramatic run-out.
0.1: Fazalhaq Farooqi offers width with a full delivery, and Brian Bennett immediately leans forward to cream an authoritative drive through the covers for four.
0.2: Fazalhaq Farooqi skids one through low and wide outside off, sneaking underneath Brian Bennett's swinging blade straight to the keeper on the bounce.
0.3: Fazalhaq Farooqi attacks the stumps on a good length, prompting Brian Bennett to stride forward and dead-bat it toward cover.
0.4: Brian Bennett does not score off Fazalhaq Farooqi.
8.1: Farooqi tests Sikandar Raza with a wide delivery, prompting a hesitant late dab down to third man off the under-edge.
8.2: Farooqi targets the channel outside off, and Brian Bennett stays back to dead-bat the ball into the off-side.
8.3: Farooqi delivers a shortish ball that Brian Bennett steers down to deep third as players battle drenched shirts in the punishing humidity.
8.4: Farooqi arrows one down leg, brushing the thigh of Sikandar Raza before Gurbaz swoops in with a brilliant diving take amidst heavy humidity.
8.5: Farooqi digs it in short and angles it into the body, allowing Sikandar Raza to turn it square toward the leg-side.
8.6: Farooqi slides a full delivery into the pads, which Sikandar Raza watches closely before tucking toward mid-wicket.
9.1: Omarzai angles one in from over the wicket, zipping past Brian Bennett's slashing blade as he looks to connect outside off.
9.2: Omarzai pulls back his length on middle stump, and Brian Bennett gets right behind the line to block solidly.
9.3: Omarzai digs it into the surface with some inward shape, and Brian Bennett stands firm to defend off the back foot.
9.4: Omarzai offers a short tennis-ball bumper outside off, and Brian Bennett ramps it superbly over the keeper to find the fence.
9.5: Omarzai curves a back-of-a-length delivery into off stump, which Brian Bennett pushes firmly through the line.
9.6: Omarzai rolls his fingers across a shorter delivery on off stump, allowing Brian Bennett to bunt it toward point.
10.1: AM Ghazanfar fires it quicker and wider, finding Sikandar Raza driving firmly toward the cover region.
10.2: AM Ghazanfar serves it up outside off, inviting the drive that Sikandar Raza drills hard before a brilliant one-handed stop at covers robs him of a boundary.
10.3: Gurbaz makes his slow exit from the arena, clearly hindered by an issue in his right hamstring.
10.4: AM Ghazanfar angles one in at the stumps, allowing Brian Bennett to tuck it neatly away toward the leg side.
10.5: Brian Bennett takes a single off AM Ghazanfar.
10.6: Sikandar Raza does not score off AM Ghazanfar.
21.1: Rashid Khan drops it on a flat good length, and Ryan Burl stays back to whip it wide of deep square-leg for an easy couple.
21.2: Rashid Khan fires a quicker good length just outside off, prompting Ryan Burl to lean back and cut straight to backward point.
21.3: Rashid Khan pitches outside leg from near the umpire, leaving Ryan Burl to flash and miss while muttering frustration at a missed opportunity.
21.4: Rashid Khan unleashes the googly on a good length that grips from middle to off, safely tucked away by Ryan Burl to mid-wicket off the back foot.
21.5: Rashid Khan tosses it full on middle with sharp inward turn, forcing Ryan Burl forward to bunt an inside edge wide of mid-wicket for a single.
21.6: Rashid Khan darts a quicker good length delivery into middle, met by a watchful back-foot nudge toward mid-wicket from Sikandar Raza.
22.1: AM Ghazanfar loops it full onto leg stump, drawing a forward drive from Ryan Burl that is mistimed straight back down the pitch.
22.2: AM Ghazanfar pushes another full delivery onto the toes, allowing Ryan Burl to stride forward and stroke it easily toward long-on.
22.3: AM Ghazanfar extracts vicious away-spin with a carrom-ball that takes Sikandar Raza's thick outside edge, dropping low past Atal at first slip in what goes down as a missed opportunity.
22.4: AM Ghazanfar offers a full delivery outside off, and Sikandar Raza leans into a firm drive directed straight to long-off.
22.5: AM Ghazanfar lands a good length ball on middle that straightens, handled securely by Ryan Burl with a composed forward defense.
22.6: AM Ghazanfar fires it in quicker and flat on a good length outside off, forcing Ryan Burl onto the back foot to tuck it cleanly toward short third man.
23.1: Rashid Khan darts one in on a brisk length outside off, forcing Sikandar Raza onto the back foot to steer it with an open face straight to backward point.
23.2: Rashid Khan keeps it flat and attacking on a good length outside off, allowing Sikandar Raza to slash square through the off-side for a single.
23.3: Rashid Khan fires a flat delivery from round the wicket onto middle, smartly punched by Ryan Burl before a sharp dive to the right at mid-wicket saves the run.
23.4: Rashid Khan tosses this one full onto leg-stump, inviting Ryan Burl forward to watchfully flick it into the mid-wicket region.
23.5: Rashid Khan delivers from deep behind the crease on a flat good length outside off, prompting Ryan Burl to rock back and hammer a cut hard to deep point for a single.
23.6: Rashid Khan drops it on a good length outside off to spin sharply back in, leaving Sikandar Raza to read the movement and safely play off the back foot in defense.
24.1: Dot ball from Mohammad Nabi to Ryan Burl.
35.1: Rashid Khan attacks the channel outside off, and Sikandar Raza steps back to steer it firmly toward backward point.
35.2: Rashid Khan floats this leg-break fuller outside off, prompting Sikandar Raza forward into a textbook defensive prod.
35.3: Rashid Khan gets this good-length ball to bite back sharply, forcing Sikandar Raza onto the back foot to punch straight to the diving mid-wicket fielder.
35.4: Rashid Khan produces a magical wrong'un that spins past Sikandar Raza's defensive push to shatter the off-stump, ending a fine knock of 48.
35.5: Wellington Masakadza survives a razor-thin LBW review as replays show umpire's call on impact after he misses a sharp turning delivery.
35.6: Rashid Khan completes a maiden over as Wellington Masakadza feathers an outside edge that is brilliantly intercepted by a diving short third man.
36.1: Mohammad Nabi tosses this slower delivery up full, allowing Brad Evans to drop low and launch it cleanly over long-on for six.
36.2: Mohammad Nabi goes around the wicket, but Brad Evans expertly deploys the reverse-sweep to beat backward point and race away to the boundary.
36.3: Mohammad Nabi fires it in on a good length into the pads, where Brad Evans turns it toward mid-wicket before being rightly sent back.
36.4: Mohammad Nabi drops it on a length, and Brad Evans marches down the track before dead-batting it safely back down the pitch.
36.5: Mohammad Nabi extracts his revenge as Brad Evans dances down the track, miscues a heave off the bottom of the bat, and picks out Ibrahim Zadran at deep mid-wicket.
36.6: Mohammad Nabi delivers a full ball on off-stump, and Masuku pushes it gently toward the fielder stationed at short fine leg.
37.1: Rashid Khan tosses this full delivery well outside leg, leaving Wellington Masakadza completely bamboozled as he attempts a flick and misses entirely.
37.2: Rashid darts another one outside the leg-stump, catching Wellington Masakadza on the back foot as he fails to connect with the whip and cops a sharp rap on the pad.
37.3: Wellington Masakadza does not score off Rashid Khan.
37.4: Wellington Masakadza does not score off Rashid Khan.
37.5: Rashid Khan operates from over the wicket, dropping a length ball onto the leg-stump which Wellington Masakadza steers off a thick inside edge toward short fine for a single.
37.6: Rashid Khan bamboozles Ernest Masuku with a vicious googly, beating the forward defensive prod entirely as the ball sneaks through the gate to rattle the middle stump.
38.1: Mohammad Nabi fires a flat delivery down the leg-side, prompting Wellington Masakadza onto the back foot to tuck it neatly toward backward square-leg.
38.2: Mohammad Nabi drifts one slower with a hint of away-turn from off, allowing Wellington Masakadza to advance and angle his bat toward backward point.
38.3: Mohammad Nabi delivers a slower good-length ball on middle, met safely on the back foot by a watchful Wellington Masakadza.
38.4: Mohammad Nabi tosses one outside off, drawing a thick edge from Wellington Masakadza that Zia chases down before firing in a direct hit to catch the batter short of his ground.
